sloka: पुत्रश्च तव देवेन्द्र न विनष्टो महारणे ।नीतः सन्निहितश्चैव आर्यकेण महोदधौ ।। ७.३०.४९ ॥
transliteration: putraśca tava devendra na vinaṣṭo mahāraṇe ।nītaḥ sannihitaścaiva āryakeṇa mahodadhau ।। 7.30.49 ॥

translations.english: O king of gods, your son did not perish in the great battle; he was taken and kept safe by Aryaka in the great ocean.
